visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Count Overflows an int
visualizerParams.problemDescription: There are 20365011074 ways to climb 50 steps, but the program prints a negative number.

solution.explanation: The numbers grow like Fibonacci numbers and exceed the largest int (about 2.1 billion) near n = 46. Java ints wrap around silently, so the result becomes a wrong, even negative, number. A long holds much larger values.
